{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where true outcomes bottom earlier and rise faster",
    "When sentiment turns positive, model forecasts undershoot true prices because they're still pricing in previous downward momentum",
    "Mean reversion bias in model - forecasts decline too slowly when prices begin falling, missing the rapid bottoming and initial recovery",
    "Sentiment alignment: when sentiment turns negative, model forecasts remain too optimistic by 1-3 price points",
    "Price level bias: model underestimates volatility at lower price ranges (below 67 EUR) and over-optimistic at higher ranges (above 73 EUR)",
    "Sentiment momentum matters - model doesn't capture acceleration effects when sentiment changes quickly",
    "Forecast divergence increases with horizon - 30d forecasts accumulate more error than shorter horizons" ]
}
